meta.name: update-nanoclaw
meta.description: Efficiently bring upstream NanoClaw updates into a customized install, with preview, selective cherry-pick, and low token usage.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预览上游更新,挑选合入定制安装
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果维护着定制版NanoClaw,想便捷同步官方更新
copy.tagline_en: Preview upstream updates and cherry-pick them into your customized install
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a customized NanoClaw and want to sync official updates

howto.what: 当你运行 /update-nanoclaw 时,Claude 会先备份当前代码,再拉取上游更新供你预览,你可选择全部合并或只挑部分提交;遇到冲突时只解决冲突标记、保留你的定制,然后自动构建测试,最后给出回滚命令。
howto.when: 当你在 Claude Code 中运行 /update-nanoclaw,想把上游 NanoClaw 更新合入定制安装时触发。

say.text: 运行 /update-nanoclaw 合入上游更新。
say.note: 它会先备份当前代码,再预览变更,然后询问合并方式。

say.text: 用 /update-nanoclaw 只挑部分提交更新。
say.note: 它会列出上游提交,等待你指定要选的提交。

say.text: 先跑 /update-nanoclaw 看看上游改了什么。
say.note: 它只展示改动,不会修改任何代码。

howto.what_en: When you run /update-nanoclaw, Claude backs up code, previews upstream changes, merges or cherry-picks, resolves only conflict markers, runs build/tests, and prints rollback info.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you run /update-nanoclaw in Claude Code to pull upstream NanoClaw changes into your customized install.

say_en.text: Run /update-nanoclaw to bring in upstream NanoClaw changes.
say_en.note: It will back up, preview, then ask how to merge.

say_en.text: Use /update-nanoclaw to cherry-pick only the commits I want.
say_en.note: It lists upstream commits and waits for your chosen hashes.

say_en.text: Preview upstream changes with /update-nanoclaw, but change nothing.
say_en.note: It shows the changelog and stops without edits.
